onb.tema_desc: This is how Lenscord will look. You can change it later in Settings.
onb.usb_pasos:
1. In Settings > About phone, tap the build number 7 times.
2. In Developer options, turn on USB debugging.
3. Plug in the cable and accept the debugging prompt on the phone.
onb.wifi_pasos:
1. Turn on Developer options and Wireless debugging on the phone.
2. Put the PC and the phone on the same network.
3. Lenscord searches on its own: when your phone shows up, press it to connect. The first time you will need to pair it with the 6-digit code shown on the phone.
